message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "Verify Pathognomonic Vascular Signs for Congenital Lung Anomalies", "description": "When evaluating right-sided lung hypoplasia or volume loss with mediastinal shift, do not diagnose Scimitar Syndrome without explicit evidence of anomalous pulmonary venous drainage.", "applicable_conditions": "Cases involving congenital lung anomalies, specifically those presenting with unilateral lung hypoplasia, volume loss, or mediastinal shift where a specific syndromic diagnosis (like Scimitar Syndrome) is being considered.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["detection", "localization", "characterization", "reasoning"], "required_tools": [], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If the agent observes right lung hypoplasia/volume loss and mediastinal shift: (1) Do NOT diagnose Scimitar Syndrome based solely on these non-specific findings; (2) Explicitly search for or verify the presence of the 'scimitar sign' (anomalous pulmonary vein draining into the IVC) via imaging analysis or clinical data; (3) Only confirm the diagnosis if this specific vascular anomaly is identified.
